name: Frogbit
desc: Frogbit (Hydrocharis morsus-ranae): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 37 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Hydrocharis morsus-ranae L. is a species of the genus Hydrocharis known by the common name European frog-bit. It is a free-floating flowering plant that bears small white flowers.
